objective.primary: Increase breakout probability by maximizing first-3-second hold, average watch time and shareability.
objective.note: 70k likes is a stretch outcome, not a guaranteed rate target.

benchmark_basis.tiktok: Recent best internal cell: Dona Herminia led Oct06 with 13.6% likes/views; historic breakout cells combine instant-recognition comedy, 18s+ watch and shares.
benchmark_basis.instagram: Historic winner reached 78.2% 3s view rate and 21.2s average watch; Oct06 best fell to 44% and 12.7s, so hooks must pay off faster.
benchmark_basis.youtube: Historic winners are recognizable Brazilian comedy/blooper Shorts with 4.4k-6.7k views; prioritize famous IP + immediate conflict.
benchmark_basis.facebook: Oct06 De Pernas pro Ar 2 reached 1,168 views but only ~4s avg watch; keep strong premise but tighten the micro-arc and payoff.
